q19406.en: The sign shown warns of traffic lights ahead.

explain.short: The red, yellow and green discs show a traffic light: the sign warns that traffic lights are coming.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia' means it warns in advance: the lights are further ahead.

q19407.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle with a red border: that shape is used for danger signs.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) = triangle with red edge, point up.

q19408.en: In the sign shown, the yellow disc can be replaced by a flashing yellow light.

explain.short: To make the sign easier to see, the yellow disc can be a real yellow light that flashes.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: Only the YELLOW disc can become a light, and it must be 'lampeggiante' (flashing).

sceneParams.caption: Yellow disc can be a flashing yellow light

q19409.en: When you see the sign shown, you must moderate your speed so you can stop if necessary.

explain.short: The light ahead may be red: slow down so you can stop in time.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'all'occorrenza' means 'if needed': you slow down to be ready, not to stop always.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down: be ready to stop at the lights

q19410.en: The sign shown has a yellow background if placed before roadworks.

explain.short: Temporary signs at roadworks have a yellow background, this one too.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'a fondo giallo' (yellow background) = sign used for roadworks ('cantiere').

sceneParams.caption: At roadworks the background is yellow

q19411.en: The sign shown warns of traffic lights with the lights arranged vertically.

explain.short: In this sign the three discs are one above the other: the lights ahead are vertical.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'in verticale' (vertical) matches the column of discs; the horizontal row is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Discs in a column: vertical traffic lights

q19412.en: The sign shown is compulsory on roads outside built-up areas.

explain.short: Outside towns drivers go fast, so this warning must be placed before every traffic light.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' means roads outside towns: there the sign is required.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns this sign is compulsory

q19413.en: On roads outside built-up areas the sign is always compulsory.

explain.short: Outside towns every traffic light must be announced by this sign.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is usually a trap word, but here it is correct.

q19414.en: The sign shown can have the red disc replaced by a flashing red light.

explain.short: Only the yellow disc can become a flashing light; the red disc cannot.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'disco rosso' (red disc) is the trap: the rule is about the YELLOW disc.

sceneParams.caption: Only the YELLOW disc can flash, not the red

q19415.en: The sign shown warns of a railway crossing without barriers.

explain.short: The discs show traffic lights, not a train: an unbarriered crossing has a locomotive sign.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'attraversamento ferroviario' (railway crossing) is a different sign, with a train.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a railway crossing

q19416.en: The sign shown can warn of a level crossing with half barriers.

explain.short: A level crossing with barriers has a fence (gate) sign; this one shows traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'passaggio a livello' (level crossing) is not shown by coloured discs.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a level crossing

q19417.en: The sign shown warns of an alternating one-way road.

explain.short: An alternating one-way stretch has its own sign with two arrows; this one is traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'senso unico alternato' (alternating one-way) is a different sign.

q19418.en: The sign shown warns of a moving (lifting) bridge.

explain.short: A moving bridge has its own sign showing the bridge; this one shows traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'ponte mobile' (moving bridge) is a different danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a moving bridge

q19419.en: The sign shown can have a steady yellow light in the centre.

explain.short: The yellow disc can only become a FLASHING yellow light, never a steady one.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo' (traffic lights) is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead. Outside towns it is compulsory, about 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'fissa' (steady) is the trap: the light must be 'lampeggiante' (flashing).

sceneParams.caption: Yellow light must flash, not stay steady

q19420.en: The sign shown warns of possible sudden dazzle caused by low-flying aeroplanes.

explain.short: A low plane can reflect the sun or use bright lights and suddenly dazzle you.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'abbagliamento' means dazzle (being blinded by light) - a real risk under low planes.

q19421.en: The sign shown warns of possible sudden loud noise caused by low-flying aeroplanes.

explain.short: A plane passing low is very loud and can surprise the driver.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'rumore' means noise: sudden noise is one of the dangers of this sign.

q19422.en: The sign shown is placed near airports.

explain.short: Planes fly low only near airports, so the sign is placed there.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'nelle vicinanze' means nearby: close to the airport.

q19423.en: The sign shown is placed near runways for the landing and take-off of aeroplanes.

explain.short: Near runways planes are low, just before landing or just after take-off.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'piste' here means runways, not ski slopes or race tracks.

sceneParams.caption: Near runways: planes land and take off

q19424.en: The sign shown is placed in areas where low-altitude flight of aeroplanes may happen.

explain.short: This is exactly the danger of the sign: planes flying low over the road.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'bassa quota' means low height (altitude).

q19425.en: The sign shown warns of a gliding site.

explain.short: The sign shows a powered plane, a noise and dazzle risk near airports, not gliders.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'volo a vela' (gliding) is a sport, not the danger of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Low planes, not a gliding site

q19426.en: The sign shown warns of an area reserved for air force vehicles.

explain.short: It is a danger sign about planes flying low, not a reserved military area.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'riservata' (reserved) is the trap: danger signs do not reserve anything.

sceneParams.caption: Danger from low planes, no reserved zone

q19427.en: The sign shown warns of a fork in the road for the airport.

explain.short: Directions to the airport are given by blue or green direction signs, not by this triangle.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'bivio' (fork, junction) is the trap: this sign shows no road layout.

sceneParams.caption: Low planes, not a junction for the airport

q19428.en: The sign shown forbids access to airports.

explain.short: A triangle only warns of danger; prohibitions are round signs.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is the trap: a danger sign never forbids.

sceneParams.caption: It warns, it does not forbid

q19429.en: The sign shown warns of a reserved lane for entering the airport.

explain.short: It warns of low-flying planes; it says nothing about lanes.
explain.rule: 'Aeromobili' (low-flying aircraft) is a danger sign near airports: planes may pass low, with sudden noise or dazzle.
explain.trap: 'corsia riservata' (reserved lane) is the trap: no lane is shown.

sceneParams.caption: Low planes, not a reserved lane

q19430.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road exposed to strong side gusts of wind.

explain.short: The windsock blown sideways shows strong wind from the side on this stretch.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'raffiche' means gusts: sudden strong blows of wind.

q19431.en: The sign shown warns of possible strong side gusts when leaving a tunnel.

explain.short: Inside a tunnel there is no wind; at the exit a gust can hit you suddenly.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'all'uscita' (at the exit) is correct: the danger is leaving the tunnel, not entering it.

q19432.en: The sign shown warns of a viaduct exposed to sudden side gusts of wind.

explain.short: A viaduct is high and open, so wind hits it hard: a typical place for this sign.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'viadotto' means viaduct (a long high bridge).

q19433.en: The sign shown warns of areas subject to strong and sudden side gusts of wind.

explain.short: This is the exact meaning of the windsock sign.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'improvvise' means sudden: the gusts come without warning.

q19434.en: The sign shown warns of a danger that is greater for vehicles with tarpaulins or box bodies.

explain.short: Vans and trucks with high flat sides catch the wind like a sail.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'telonati o furgonati' = with a tarpaulin cover or a closed box: big side surface.

sceneParams.caption: Box vans and tarpaulin trucks: more danger

q19435.en: The sign shown warns you to proceed with care, holding the steering wheel firmly.

explain.short: A gust can push the car sideways: hold the wheel firmly and drive carefully.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'saldamente' means firmly, with a strong grip.

q19436.en: The sign shown warns of low-flying aeroplanes.

explain.short: The picture is a windsock, not a plane: the low-flying aircraft sign shows an aeroplane.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'aeroplani' is the trap: a windsock is seen at airfields, but here it means wind.

q19437.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road near an airport.

explain.short: The sign warns of side wind, wherever it is; it is not linked to airports.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'aeroporto' is the trap: windsocks are at airports, but this sign means wind.

q19438.en: The sign shown warns of an airfield.

explain.short: The windsock here means strong side wind, not an airfield.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'campo d'aviazione' (airfield) is the trap.

q19439.en: The sign shown indicates which direction the wind comes from.

explain.short: The drawing is always the same: it does not show the real wind direction.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'da quale direzione' is the trap: the sign warns of wind, not its direction.

sceneParams.caption: It does not show the wind direction

q19440.en: The sign shown warns of a playground nearby.

explain.short: The striped tube is a windsock, not a toy: it warns of side wind.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'parco giochi' (playground) is the trap.

q19441.en: The sign shown warns of industrial buildings nearby.

explain.short: The pole with a striped tube is a windsock, not a factory: it warns of side wind.
explain.rule: 'Forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a danger sign: sudden gusts from the side. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'capannoni industriali' (industrial sheds) is the trap.

q19442.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns of a danger that is greater for vehicles towing trailers.

explain.short: A trailer is pushed by the wind and can swing, so the danger is greater.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'rimorchi' means trailers: more side surface, more danger.

sceneParams.caption: Trailers: greater danger in side wind

q19443.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns of a danger that is greater for two-wheeled vehicles.

explain.short: Motorbikes and bicycles are light and narrow: a gust can easily push them over.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'veicoli a due ruote' = motorbikes, mopeds, bicycles.

q19444.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns of a danger that is greater for vehicles towing caravans.

explain.short: A caravan has big flat sides that catch the wind like a sail.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'caravan' = tall towed trailer: large side surface.

q19445.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown requires you to proceed with care, holding the wheel with a firmer grip.

explain.short: Gusts push the car sideways, so you hold the wheel more firmly.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'presa più sicura' means a firmer grip on the wheel.

q19446.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns that tarpaulin vehicles need to slow down and, if necessary, stop.

explain.short: Tarpaulin trucks are very exposed to wind: they slow down and, if it is too strong, stop.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'all'occorrenza' means if needed: stopping only when necessary.

sceneParams.caption: Tarpaulin trucks: slow down, stop if needed

q19447.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns that vehicles coming the other way may swerve.

explain.short: The wind also pushes oncoming vehicles, which can suddenly drift into your lane.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'senso opposto' means the opposite direction: oncoming traffic.

q19448.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns of a danger that grows as the vehicle's side surface grows.

explain.short: A bigger side means more wind pushing on it, so more danger.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'all'aumentare' means 'as it grows': bigger side, bigger danger.

q19449.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns of a greater danger at tunnel entrances for narrow, tall vehicles.

explain.short: The sudden gust comes at the EXIT of a tunnel, not at the entrance.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'all'entrata' (at the entrance) is the trap: the danger is 'all'uscita' (at the exit).

sceneParams.caption: Danger is at the tunnel EXIT

q19450.en: The sign shown warns of an area where, in strong side wind, vehicles with a trailer hold the road better.

explain.short: A trailer catches wind and can swing: it holds the road WORSE.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'maggiore tenuta di strada' (better grip on the road) is the opposite of the truth.

sceneParams.caption: Trailers hold the road WORSE in wind

q19451.en: The sign shown warns of an area where, in strong side wind, empty or light vehicles hold the road better.

explain.short: Light or empty vehicles are pushed more easily by the wind: they hold the road worse.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'scarichi o leggeri' (empty or light) is the trap: light means less grip, not more.

sceneParams.caption: Light vehicles hold the road WORSE

q19452.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown warns of a danger that is smaller for vehicles with bulky loads on the roof.

explain.short: A roof load makes the side surface bigger and higher: the danger is GREATER.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'minore' (smaller) is the trap: it should be 'maggiore' (greater).

sceneParams.caption: Roof load: GREATER danger, not smaller

q19453.en: In strong side wind, the sign shown lets you overtake with a smaller side distance from the vehicle you are passing.

explain.short: In wind vehicles may swerve, so you need MORE side distance, never less.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'riducendo la distanza laterale' (reducing side distance) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: In wind keep MORE side distance

q19454.en: The sign shown warns of the entrance to a tunnel.

explain.short: The windsock warns of side wind; a tunnel has its own sign.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'ingresso in galleria' (tunnel entrance) is the trap.

q19455.en: The sign shown warns of possible ice on the road.

explain.short: Ice has its own sign (a snowflake); the windsock means side wind.
explain.rule: Strong side wind pushes vehicles sideways; the larger the side surface, the bigger the danger. Hold the wheel firmly and slow down.
explain.trap: 'ghiaccio' (ice) is the trap.

q19456.en: The sign shown warns that you are crossing an area at risk of fire.

explain.short: The tree with flames below means a zone where fires start easily.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'incendio' means fire (a large fire, like a forest fire).

q19457.en: The sign shown warns that areas at high risk of fire are near.

explain.short: This is the meaning of the sign: high fire risk close to the road.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'alto rischio' means high risk.

q19458.en: The sign shown indicates that you are approaching an easily flammable wood.

explain.short: Dry woods burn easily; the tree in the picture shows this.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'infiammabile' means it can catch fire easily.

q19459.en: The sign shown warns of areas beside the road at high risk of fire.

explain.short: The danger is next to the road: woods or dry grass that can burn.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'laterali' means at the sides of the road.

sceneParams.caption: Fire risk at the sides of the road

q19460.en: The sign shown is completed by a panel showing the length of the stretch of road concerned.

explain.short: Fire-risk areas can be long, so a panel tells you for how many metres or km.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'pannello' means an extra small plate under the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Panel gives length of the stretch

q19461.en: With this sign, if the driver or passengers break the ban on throwing lit cigarettes out of the window, a fire may start.

explain.short: A lit cigarette in dry grass can easily start a fire; throwing it out is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'gettare sigarette accese' means throwing lit cigarettes.

q19462.en: The sign shown warns of crossing an area at risk of explosions.

explain.short: The picture shows a burning tree: the risk is fire, not explosions.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'esplosioni' (explosions) is the trap; the word is 'incendio' (fire).

q19463.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road lined with stone quarries, with risk of explosions.

explain.short: There are no quarries in the picture: it is a tree with flames, a fire risk.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'cave di pietra' (stone quarries) is the trap.

q19464.en: The sign shown forbids transit to vehicles carrying explosives.

explain.short: A triangle only warns; a ban is a round sign.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is the trap: danger signs never forbid.

sceneParams.caption: It warns, it does not forbid

q19465.en: The sign shown forbids transit to vehicles carrying easily flammable products.

explain.short: It warns of fire risk in the area; it bans nobody. Bans are round signs.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: It warns, it does not forbid

q19466.en: The sign shown forbids transit to vehicles carrying flammable liquids.

explain.short: A triangle never forbids: it only warns of fire risk.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: It warns, it does not forbid

q19467.en: The sign shown warns of possible strong side wind.

explain.short: Side wind has a windsock sign; this one shows a tree on fire.
explain.rule: 'Pericolo d'incendio' (fire risk) is a danger sign: areas beside the road can easily catch fire. Never throw lit cigarettes.
explain.trap: 'vento laterale' (side wind) is the trap.

q19468.en: The sign shown warns of a junction of two or more roads outside towns, regulated as a roundabout.

explain.short: The circle of arrows means a roundabout: roads meet and traffic goes round.
explain.rule: 'Circolazione rotatoria' (roundabout) is a danger sign: a junction ahead where traffic goes round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.trap: 'circolazione rotatoria' means roundabout traffic.

q19469.en: The sign shown warns of a junction of several roads where traffic flows in the direction shown by the arrows.

explain.short: At a roundabout you must go round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.rule: 'Circolazione rotatoria' (roundabout) is a danger sign: a junction ahead where traffic goes round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.trap: 'nel senso indicato dalle frecce' means following the arrows' direction.

sceneParams.caption: Go round as the arrows show

q19470.en: The sign shown can also be used in built-up areas.

explain.short: Roundabouts exist in towns too, so the sign can be used there as well.
explain.rule: 'Circolazione rotatoria' (roundabout) is a danger sign: a junction ahead where traffic goes round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) is correct: in towns and outside towns.

q19471.en: The sign shown forbids turning right at the first junction.

explain.short: A triangle only warns of a roundabout; it does not forbid any turn.
explain.rule: 'Circolazione rotatoria' (roundabout) is a danger sign: a junction ahead where traffic goes round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is the trap: danger signs never forbid.

sceneParams.caption: Warns of roundabout, no turn ban

q19472.en: The sign shown warns of a dead-end road, so you must turn back.

explain.short: Round arrows mean going round a roundabout, not turning back.
explain.rule: 'Circolazione rotatoria' (roundabout) is a danger sign: a junction ahead where traffic goes round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.trap: 'senza uscita' (dead end) is the trap: it is a different, square sign.

q19473.en: The sign shown warns of a compulsory left turn.

explain.short: It is a danger triangle for a roundabout; compulsory directions are round blue signs.
explain.rule: 'Circolazione rotatoria' (roundabout) is a danger sign: a junction ahead where traffic goes round in the direction of the arrows.
explain.trap: 'obbligatoria' (compulsory) is the trap: a triangle never gives orders.

q19474.en: The sign shown warns of a danger different from those that have their own specific sign.

explain.short: The exclamation mark is used for dangers that have no sign of their own.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'diverso' (different) is correct: it covers all the 'other' dangers.

sceneParams.caption: A danger with no specific sign

q19475.en: The sign shown warns that you must use caution because a danger is near.

explain.short: Every danger sign asks for caution; the '!' says a danger is close.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'prudenza' means caution, careful driving.

q19476.en: Sign (A), completed with panel (B), warns of possible ice forming.

explain.short: The panel with snowflakes tells you which danger: ice on the road.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'ghiaccio' means ice; the snowflakes on the panel show it.

q19477.en: The sign shown can be used without extra panels to show a general danger in an emergency.

explain.short: In an emergency there may be no time for a panel: the '!' alone warns of a general danger.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'senza pannelli' (without panels) is correct only 'in caso di emergenza'.

sceneParams.caption: Alone, in an emergency: general danger

q19478.en: Sign (A), completed with panel (B), warns of shunting railway tracks at industrial plants.

explain.short: The panel with locomotives shows trains moving near factories (shunting tracks).
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'binari di manovra' means tracks where trains move slowly to be arranged.

q19479.en: Sign (A), completed with panel (B), warns of snow ploughs possibly working on the road.

explain.short: The panel shows a snowflake and a snowplough: snow-clearing vehicles at work.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'sgombraneve' means snowplough (a vehicle that clears snow).

sceneParams.caption: Snowplough panel: snow ploughs at work

q19480.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road in bad condition or with an uneven surface.

explain.short: Uneven road has its own sign (a wavy line); the '!' is for other dangers.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'cattivo stato' (bad condition) is the trap: that is 'strada deformata'.

q19481.en: The sign shown warns that you must go straight on.

explain.short: 'Go straight' is a round blue sign with an arrow; the '!' only warns of danger.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' (go straight on) is the trap: an exclamation mark is not an arrow.

q19482.en: The sign shown warns of a steep uphill slope.

explain.short: A steep hill has its own sign with a slope and a percentage.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'salita ripida' (steep climb) is the trap.

q19483.en: Sign (A), completed with panel (B), warns of a level crossing without barriers.

explain.short: The panel shows shunting tracks at factories; an unbarriered level crossing has its own locomotive triangle.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'passaggio a livello senza barriere' is the trap: it has its own specific sign.

sceneParams.caption: Shunting tracks, not a level crossing

q19484.en: Sign (A), completed with panel (B), warns of military vehicles manoeuvring.

explain.short: The panel shows a digger-type work machine: work machines on the road, not military vehicles.
explain.rule: 'Altri pericoli' (other danger) is the exclamation mark danger sign: a danger with no specific sign of its own. A panel under it can say which danger.
explain.trap: 'veicoli militari' (military vehicles) is the trap: the drawing is a work machine.
